decisions.reason: As a flagship digital workflow product line tightly integrated with the core dental software and the firm's strategic direction, it would usually be retained and further developed rather than withdrawn.

The continuing education offer strengthens customer loyalty, training, and software adoption, so management would normally keep it as a complementary service despite it being less central than the core software.
A practice analytics dashboard fits well with the firm's focus on efficient practice management and data-driven improvements, making continuation more likely than exit.
A complete practice bundle is very close to the established business and likely supports sales and customer lock-in, so it has a low likelihood of being taken off the market.

Because the job and practice listing portal is comparatively distant from the firm's core software business and likely less defensible strategically, management would be inclined to redeploy resources away from it.
